insight: Founded in 2019; raised ~$18M backed by Bain Capital Ventures before narrowing to media-agency analytics.
name: Akkio
tagline: No-code predictive analytics and forecasting for media and agency teams.
description: A no-code AI platform for building predictive models, forecasts, and audience segments from business data. Users connect a CSV or live source like Salesforce, HubSpot, or Snowflake and build models through chat and drag-and-drop, then generate client-ready reports. Now focused on media agencies and marketing analytics use cases.

modelSupport.notes: Builds its own ML models for prediction and forecasting; chat-driven exploration on top.

edge: Narrowed from generic no-code ML to media/agency analytics — forecasting and audience models tuned for marketing data.
pros: Build models via chat and drag-and-drop
cons: Less depth than full DS platforms
